body:
## Summary

Only the supplier inputs of PR1673's ledger change (complex saving b = 0.00167975495612554, native profile {1:1560432,2:336336,3:278724,4:84912,5:54612,8:5328,48:22748}; c, m=73, W=66304 and all formulas/inequalities unchanged; the free strict slacks r0, zeta, layout slack, q gap, stop exponent, decimal floor and backoff are retuned to 1e-12, 1e-14, 1e-12, 1e-14, 1e-15, 1e-30, 1e-17, each only needing to be positive in PR1673's proof; additionally the boundary matrix exponent is improved from Strassen (omega<45/16, c=3/32) to omega<=2.7743 (c=0.11285) using the exact rational rank-40 scheme <3,3,6;40> (Smirnov; Dumas, Pernet, Sedoglavic data), whose full tensor identity and rotations are verified exactly by outer/check_tensor.py); the 45 strict inequalities, 5 rejecting controls and the endpoint rejection are regenerated, the supplier's full native admission is rerun.
